18501.meaning1: having removed one's hand from the bowl

examples.text: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ oṇītapattapāṇiṃ ticīvarena acchādesi, ekam'ekañ'ca bhikkhuṃ ekam'ekena dussayugena acchādesi.

18503.meaning1: gives as a present; dedicates (something to)
18503.notes: (PED) pours water ritually (over the hands) in giving a gift

examples.text: oṇojeth'āvuso, saṅghassa cīvaran'ti.

18504.meaning1: gave as a present; dedicated (something to)
18504.notes: (PED) pours water ritually (over the hands) in giving a gift

examples.text: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro sovaṇṇamayaṃ bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā bhagavato oṇojesi
atha kho ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ.

18505.commentary: (THIa) so valīhi sukhumāhi otato'ti so mama kāyo idāni sukhumāhi valīhi tahiṃ tahiṃ vitato valittacataṃ āpanno.

examples.text: kañcanassaphalakaṃ'va sammaṭṭhaṃ, sobhate su kāyo pure mama, so valīhi sukhumāhi otato, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

18508.commentary: (SNa) kusobbhe otarantī'ti-ādīsu ayam'anupubbikathā, nāginiyo kira utusamaye patiṭṭhitagabbhā cintenti, sace mayaṃ idha vijāyissāma, evaṃ no dārakā ūmivegañ'ca supaṇṇassa ca pakkhanditvā āgatassa vegaṃ sahituṃ na sakkhissantī'ti tā mahāsamudde nimujjitvā sambhajjamukhadvāraṃ patvā pañca mahānadiyo pavisitvā himavantaṃ gacchanti. tattha supaṇṇehi apakkhandanīyāsu suvaṇṇarajatamaṇiguhāsu vasamānā vijāyitvā nāgapotake gopphakādipamāṇesu udakesu otāretvā udakataraṇaṃ sikkhāpenti.

examples.text: te tattha kāyaṃ vaḍḍhetvā balaṃ gāhetvā kusobbhe otaranti, kusobbhe otaritvā mahāsobbhe otaranti, mahāsobbhe otaritvā kunnadiyo otaranti.

18509.commentary: (ANa) na c'eva sutte otarantī'ti suttapaṭipāṭiyā katthaci anāgantvā challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā guḷhavessantara-guḷhaummagga-guḷhavinaya-vedallapiṭakānaṃ aññatarato āgatāni paññāyantī'ti attho.

examples.text: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c'eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, addhā, idaṃ na c'eva tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa, imassa ca bhikkhuno duggahitan'ti.
so pana dhamm'āsanato otaranto dhammakathiko viya, nisseṇito otaranto puriso viya, ca dve ca hatthe dve ca pāde pasāretvā
pāto majjh'anhikaṃ sāyaṃ, tikkhattuṃ divasass'ahaṃ, otariṃ udakaṃ so'haṃ, gayāya gayaphagguyā.
yassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto, sadā udakam'otari, tam'eva brahme mā kāsi, mā te sītaṃ chaviṃ hane.
evañ'hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ puna otarituṃ, seyyathā'pi pubbe.

18514.meaning1: having descended; having gone down; having entered
18514.meaning2: having descended, having gone down to

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
te tattha kāyaṃ vaḍḍhetvā balaṃ gāhetvā kusobbhe otaranti, kusobbhe otaritvā mahāsobbhe otaranti, mahāsobbhe otaritvā kunnadiyo otaranti.

18516.meaning2: warms; warms in the sun, dries; puts (in the sun) to dry

18517.meaning2: sunning; warming in the sun; drying in the sun
18517.commentary: (SNa) piṭṭhiṃ otāpayamāno'ti yasmā sammāsambuddhassa'pi upādinnakasarīre uṇhakāle uṇhaṃ hoti, sītakāle sītaṃ, ayañ'ca himapātasītasamayo. tasmā mahācīvaraṃ otāretvā sūriyarasmīhi piṭṭhiṃ otāpayamāno nisīdi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pacch'ātape nisinno hoti piṭṭhiṃ otāpayamāno.

18520.meaning1: drying; sunning; drying in the sun
18520.commentary: (VINa) otāpento gacchatī'ti ātape otāpento āgantvā uddharissāmī'ti gacchati, evaṃ gacchato anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti uddharitvā gacchati, uddharāpetvā gacchati, āpucchaṃ gacchati, otāpento gacchati, kenaci palibuddhaṃ hoti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
kaliṅgar'ūpadhānā, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.
yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, labhati tassa māro otāraṃ, labhati tassa māro ārammaṇaṃ.
satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.

18524.meaning1: point of entry; space to go in
18524.commentary: (MNa) labhetha otāran'ti labheyya pavesanaṃ, vinivijjhitvā yāva pariyosānā gaccheyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso garukaṃ silāguḷaṃ allamattikāpuñje pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ garukaṃ silāguḷaṃ allamattikāpuñje labhetha otāran'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

18527.meaning2: causes to descend, makes go down (into), fetches down; lets down, lowers, puts down; takes down, removes; makes appear, puts forward; makes alight

18528.meaning1: gets a chance; finds an opportunity; gains entry

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso lahukaṃ suttaguḷaṃ sabbasāramaye aggaḷaphalake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso taṃ lahukaṃ suttaguḷaṃ sabbasāramaye aggaḷaphalake labhetha otāran'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito, app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ

18530.meaning1: looking for an opening; seeking a weak point; waiting for an opportunity
18530.meaning2: looking for an opening; longing for a weak point
18530.commentary: (SNa) otār'āpekkho'ti sace samaṇassa gotamassa kāyadvār'ādīsu kiñci'd'eva ananucchavikaṃ passāmi, codessāmi nan'ti evaṃ vivaraṃ apekkhamāno.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā sattavassāni bhagavantaṃ anubandho hoti otār'āpekkho otāraṃ alabhamāno.

18534.grammar: prp of caus pass of ava √tar, caus, pass, intrans (+loc)

examples.text: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c'eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, addhā, idaṃ na c'eva tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa, imassa ca bhikkhuno duggahitan'ti.

18535.meaning1: should be checked; should be gone into (in); should be cross-referenced
18535.meaningLit: to cause to be crossed down

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.

18537.meaning1: makes enter; causes to enter down

examples.text: ambho, rukkha, pubbe tvaṃ olambakaṃ otārento viya ujukam'eva phalāni pātesi

18542.meaning1: (of talk) introducing; bringing in; descending; diving (into)

examples.text: bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmetī'ti āgantukakathaṃ otārento purimakathaṃ bahiddhā apanāmeti. tatr'idaṃ vatthu, bhikkhū kira sannipatitvā ekaṃ daharaṃ, āvuso, tvaṃ imañ'c'imañ'ca āpattiṃ āpanno'ti āhaṃsu. so āha, bhante, nāgadīpaṃ gato'mhī'ti.

18545.commentary: (ANa) otiṇṇo'ti anupaviṭṭho. yassa hi jāti antopaviṭṭhā, so jātiyā otiṇṇo nāma.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
yena sallena otiṇṇo, disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam'eva sallam'abbuyha, na dhāvati na sīdati.
tesaṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanā saṃsaggo ahosi, saṃsagge sati vissāso ahosi, vissāse sati otāro ahosi, te otiṇṇacittā sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsū'ti.

ekass'eva hi attabhāvassa tappaccayā vināso hoti, na apāyesu aparicchinna-dukkh'ānubhavanaṃ. mātugāmena pana ālāpasallāpe sati vissāso hoti, vissāse sati otāro hoti, otiṇṇacitto sīlabyasanaṃ patvā apāyapūrako hoti, tasmā anālāpo'ti āha.

18548.meaning1: I am afflicted (with); I am victim (of); I am immersed (in)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.

18550.meaning1: (gram) letter o; 8th letter of the alphabet; guttural-labial vowel

examples.text: vaca'icc'etassa dhātussa akāro ottam'āpajjate ajjatanimhi vibhattimhi. avoca. avocuṃ. ajjatanimhī'ti kim'atthaṃ? avaca, avacū.

18552.meaning1: feels shame; feels remorse; feels embarrassed; is afraid (of)
18552.meaning2: feels ashamed or bashful; is afraid (of doing wrong); is scrupulous (to avoid, with instrumental, genitive, and, rarely, accusative); (also ottappati)

examples.text: atha vā ātāpappaṭipakkho anātāpo, kosajjaṃ so assa atthī'ti anātāpī. yaṃ na ottapati ottappitabbena, na ottapati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā'ti evaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ anottappaṃ anottāpo. so assa atthī'ti anottāpī'ti evam'ettha attho veditabbo.

18553.meaning1: regret; shame in wrongdoing; respect for others; (comm) originating from outside

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, dhammā sukkā lokaṃ pālenti. katame dve? hirī ca ottappañ'ca.
ahirikassa purisapuggalassa hirī hoti parikkamanāya, anottāpissa purisapuggalassa ottappaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, appassutassa purisapuggalassa bāhusaccaṃ hoti parikkamanāya

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, hirigāravatā, ottappagāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

18555.meaning2: feels a sense of guilt, is afraid of evil

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ottappadhanaṃ.
seyyathā'pi rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco c'eva vitthato ca, evam'evaṃ kho, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena

18556.meaning1: feels embarrassed (by); is afraid of wrongdoing

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma suṇisā sasuraṃ disvā ottappati hirīyati, evam'eva sakkassa devānam'indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.

18557.meaning1: wealth that is shame in wrongdoing

examples.text: aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo. tass'imāni dhanāni honti, seyyath'idaṃ, saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hiridhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

18558.meaning1: power that is a sense of remorse; strength of shame in wrongdoing

examples.text: satta balāni, saddhābalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
addasaṃsu kho sakkassa devānam'indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.

18560.meaning2: felt a sense of guilt, was afraid of evil

18561.meaning1: regret; shame in wrongdoing; respect for others

examples.text: saddhābalaṃ vīriyañ'ca, hirī ottappiyaṃ balaṃ, satibalaṃ samādhi ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ balaṃ, etehi balavā bhikkhu, sukhaṃ jīvati paṇḍito.
saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ, hirī ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ, sutadhanañ'ca cāgo ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.
saddho hi, bhikkhave, hatthako āḷavako, sīlavā, bhikkhave, hatthako āḷavako, hirīmā, bhikkhave, hatthako āḷavako, ottappī, bhikkhave, hatthako āḷavako

examples.text: pare anottāpī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha ottāpī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

18567.synonym: ajjhotthata, ottharita, onaddha, kuṇṭhita, guṇṭhita, sañchanna
18567.commentary: (DHPa) māluvā sālamiv'otthatan'ti yassa puggalassa taṃ taṇhāsaṅkhātaṃ dussīlyaṃ yathā nāma māluvā sālaṃ ottharantī deve vassante pattehi udakaṃ sampaṭicchitvā sambhañjanavasena sabbatthakam'eva pariyonandhati, evaṃ attabhāvaṃ otthataṃ pariyonandhitvā ṭhitaṃ. (THa) tesaṃ jālena otthato abhibhūto'ti anusayājāla'm'otthato. m'akāro padasandhikaro, gāthāsukh'atthaṃ dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yassa accantadussīlyaṃ, māluvā sālam'iv'otthataṃ, karoti so tath'attānaṃ, yathā naṃ icchatī diso.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, appaharite kato haritaṃ ottharati, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dakkho kevaṭṭo vā kevaṭṭ'antevāsī vā sukhum'acchikena jālena parittaṃ udakadahaṃ otthareyya. tassa evam'assa, ye kho keci imasmiṃ udakadahe oḷārikā pāṇā, sabbe te antojālīkatā.

18572.meaning2: having caused (something) to be overwhelmed or crushed or submerged

18577.meaning1: having hit; having fallen on top (of)
18577.commentary: (VINa) ottharitvā'ti akkamitvā. so kira tehi ākaḍḍhiyamāno patito.

18580.synonym: ambu, uda, udaka, oka, odaka, ka, jala, toya, daka, ninnaga, vāri, salila

18590.commentary: (MNa) odanakummāsūpacayassā'ti odanena c'eva kummāsena ca upacitassa vaḍḍhitassa.

18591.commentary: (SNa) odanakummāsūpacayassā'ti odanena c'eva kummāsena ca upacitassa vaḍḍhitassa.

examples.text: gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.
ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.

18595.commentary: (VINt) evaṃ pūve odane ca bhājane pakkhipitvā tajjaṃ udakaṃ datvā madditvā katā pūvasurā odanasurā'ti ca vuccati.

examples.text: surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.

18598.meaning2: rice seller's house; cooked rice shop
